intro: The manual pages this course keeps sending you to, plus the references you will want once the chapters are done. Everything opens on php.net, so you can read it beside the chapter you are on.

items.label: Getting started
items.note: What PHP is for, and what a first page looks like.

items.label: Language reference
items.note: The full syntax, chapter by chapter. This is where the course's chapters point.

items.label: Function reference
items.note: Everything already built in, grouped by extension.

items.label: Variables and constants
items.note: The $ sigil, scope, variable variables, constants.

items.label: Types
items.note: int, float, string, bool, array, null, objects, and how PHP converts between them.

items.label: Operators
items.note: Including the comparison table that explains == versus ===.

items.label: Control structures
items.note: if, loops, match, and the alternative syntax used inside templates.

items.label: Functions
items.note: User-defined functions, arguments, return types, first-class callables.

items.label: Arrays
items.note: The type everything in PHP is built from.

items.label: Strings
items.note: Interpolation, heredoc, and the string functions.

items.label: Variables from external sources
items.note: How form fields, query strings and cookies arrive as arrays.

items.label: $_POST
items.note: Data sent in the request body.

items.label: $_GET
items.note: Data sent in the query string.

items.label: Sessions
items.note: The introduction to sessions, and how the session id travels.

items.label: session_start()
items.note: Create or resume the session, with the configuration options that matter.

items.label: htmlspecialchars()
items.note: The one function to call before echoing user input into HTML.

items.label: Classes and objects
items.note: The basics: classes, properties, methods, the -> operator.

items.label: Constructors and property promotion
items.note: How GradeCalculator's constructor sets four readonly properties in one line.

items.label: Visibility
items.note: public, protected, private, and what readonly adds.

items.label: Inheritance
items.note: extends, parent::, abstract classes and methods.

items.label: Interfaces
items.note: The contract a class promises to honour.

items.label: Traits
items.note: Shared method bodies without a class hierarchy.

items.label: Enumerations
items.note: Typed choices instead of magic strings.

items.label: Exceptions
items.note: throw, try, catch, finally, and extending Exception.

items.label: Autoloading (PSR-4)
items.note: How App\ maps to src/ without a single require line.

items.label: Namespaces
items.note: The syntax behind use and the leading backslash.

items.label: Composer
items.note: Dependencies, autoloading and scripts — not part of the manual.

items.label: PHP-FIG standards
items.note: The PSR documents this project follows.
